# `count_min_sketch`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a count-min sketch of a column with the given esp,
confidence and seed. The result is an array of bytes, which can be deserialized to a
`CountMinSketch` before usage. Count-min sketch is a probabilistic data structure used for
cardinality estimation using sub-linear space.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
count_min_sketch(col, eps, confidence, seed)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 4 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- count_min_sketch, example 1
> SELECT hex(count_min_sketch(col, 0.5d, 0.5d, 1)) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (1) AS tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
